text: For the postmortem: what time did I first report the kiosks offline on 3 Aug, and what was the guard doing in the meantime?
reply_text:
I replied in the thread under your message.

Per the #inc-vtg-hartford history, your first report was at 10:42 AM on 3 Aug. In the meantime, the guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard, six trucks were waiting at the east gate by 10:44, and kiosk 1 came back at 11:03 when Mateo checked in trailer 8836. You confirmed both lanes working at 11:07.

I also flagged SUP-5380 (Hartford gate kiosks offline, Sev 1), which logs an update at 08:12 on 3 Aug: "Rebot failed; drivers queueing." The entry has no author, so it may or may not be your report. If it was, the first report would be 08:12, not 10:42. Check that before the postmortem goes out.

text: And mine: which ticket holds the status-page screenshot for Mateo's access problem?
reply_text: The status-page screenshot is attached to INC-4821. That comes from Gideon's 11:08 AM message on 3 Aug in #inc-vtg-hartford. I can't open the ticket from here, so I haven't checked the attachment itself. I replied in your thread.
